abstain_reason: This clause is purely definitional, establishing the meaning of the term 'token' as used in this document. It describes what a token is (an atomic unit of text or multimodal data), explains that messages are tokenized before entering the model, notes that tokens measure input/output length, and observes that models have fixed token limits. However, it does not itself impose any obligations, permissions, prohibitions, or behavioral requirements on the model. It is reference material and terminology that other clauses may depend on, not a normative statement about what the model must, may, or must not do.
